texts.kicker-0: COMPUTER SCIENCE AT UNIVERSITI TEKNOLOGI PETRONAS
texts.bio-0: Final-year Computer Science student with a finance minor. I build machine learning systems, IoT pipelines and apps, mostly in Python, Flutter and React.
texts.about-about-p-0: I'm a Computer Science student at Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS (UTP) in my final year, with a minor in finance. Most of what I build sits where data meets real-world problems: machines, money, air quality, everyday life.
texts.about-about-p-1: My final year project is an IoT predictive maintenance system for oil & gas equipment. It goes from an ESP32 vibration sensor all the way to an explainable ML model and a live dashboard. Outside class I join hackathons and data competitions, and I build small apps for the people around me.
texts.about-about-p-2: I like projects that actually get used, even if the users are just my housemates.
texts.tl-item-h4-0: 4th runner-up at the ExxonMobil DataWorks Challenge
texts.tl-item-p-0: Team 4Beans (UTP) reached the top 5 finals for ML-assisted history matching and production forecasting.
texts.tl-item-p-1: Shipped Fulfil, GapHelp, FreePeriod and GameSense across four Devpost hackathons.
texts.tl-item-p-2: Started collecting Normal / Degraded / Fault vibration data from a lathe with ESP32 + MQTT, live into the Flask dashboard.
texts.tl-item-p-3: CRISP-DM framework, algorithm comparison and SHAP explainability, with all examiner feedback addressed.
texts.tl-item-p-4: IoT-based predictive maintenance for oil & gas equipment, validated on the CWRU bearing dataset.
texts.contact-contact-div-first-child-p-0: Want to team up for a hackathon, talk ML, or see a project up close?
texts.contact-contact-div-first-child-p-1: Best way to reach me is below. I usually reply within a day or two (probably with headphones on 🎧).

projects.title: IoT Predictive Maintenance System
projects.desc: Predicts faults in industrial rotating equipment for the oil & gas industry. ESP32 + MPU-6050 stream vibration data over MQTT into a Python ML pipeline, shown on a Flask dashboard with Operator and Engineer views.
projects.impact: Works end to end, from live sensor to dashboard

projects.title: ExxonMobil DataWorks Challenge 2026
projects.desc: ML-assisted history matching and production forecasting for oil & gas reservoirs. Came in new to the domain and learned it during the competition.

projects.title: Explainable PM2.5 Prediction
projects.desc: Next-hour PM2.5 prediction and air quality category classification for Europe, using about 10 years (2016 to 2026) of OpenAQ multi-pollutant sensor data plus temperature and humidity.

projects.title: GameSense
projects.desc: Open-source football (soccer) analytics project built for a sports data competition on Devpost.
projects.impact: Pivoted from an F1 pit-strategy idea to football

projects.title: Fulfil
projects.desc: A fitness and nutrition app against crash dieting, with AI meal logging. I wrote the code; Lester did UI/UX and the demo video.
projects.impact: Shipped as a Flutter web demo

projects.title: GapHelp
projects.desc: Breaks tasks into small steps and fits them into the gap before your next event, with a 'leave now' alarm so you're never late. Started as a Chrome extension called Save Point.

projects.title: FreePeriod
projects.desc: An AI-first version of GapHelp, rebuilt for an AI-themed hackathon.
projects.impact: More AI in the task planning

projects.title: Entrepreneur Eagle Companion
projects.desc: Finance companion for SMEs: financial projection, grant matching, document vault and cash-flow tracking. A teammate built the app (Woodpecker); I built the pitch deck.
